$comment: R01 budgets for bench/orm-gate.mjs and bench/typecheck-gate.mjs. Reference machine: Apple M4 (10 cores, 24 GiB), macOS, Node 22.23.2, PostgreSQL 17.11 (Homebrew, shared_buffers 128MB), pg 8.22.0, postgres 3.4.8, 2026-09-25; the full-profile run is bench/baseline.json.

serverRatioVsHandMax: the compiled relational statement vs the same correlated shape written by hand, EXPLAIN ANALYZE medians interleaved in one run (machine-independent). Measured 0.90-1.09 after the json_* change; the previous jsonb_* compiler measured 1.49/1.70/1.85 and must fail. 1.35 leaves room for run noise and nothing else.

ciCeilings.p95Ms: absolute client p95 ceilings for the CI profile, about 10x the reference-machine p95 (indexed) and 10x the unindexed p50, so shared runners pass and an N+1, a lost index or a cartesian product fails. Never raise one to make a regression pass.
ciCeilings.streamEarlyExitReleaseP95Ms: reference p95 0.25 ms; 250 ms is a hang detector, not a speed claim.
sameMachine: --compare against a baseline recorded on the same machine: p50 may not regress more than regressionPct unless the change is also below absoluteFloorMs (sub-millisecond scheduler noise).
typecheck: per TypeScript version, types/instantiations of the generated 100-table depth-3 consumer project (deterministic); regressionPct is the V16 20% allowance.
